course.5.desc: Learn to process images, apply convolutions, and build models for object detection and classification.
course.6.title: Reinforcement Learning
course.6.desc: Master Markov decision processes, Q-learning, policy gradients, and decision making under uncertainty.
course.7.title: GANs & Generative AI
course.7.desc: Learn about Generative Adversarial Networks, image generation, autoencoders, and diffusion models.
course.8.title: AI Ethics & Governance
course.8.desc: Analyze bias in AI, ethical frameworks, privacy, regulations, and responsible deployment models.
course.9.title: MLOps & Deployment
course.9.desc: Bridge the gap between model development and deployment. Setup pipelines, monitoring, and scaling.

landing.hero.subtitle: An intelligent, immersive environment to track, learn, and master your technical roadmap.
landing.beta.title: Welcome to the Beta version!
landing.beta.desc: We have launched the public beta of the platform. The core functionality, including course generation and the knowledge graph, is now available. You might encounter minor bugs, but we are actively working to resolve them.
landing.overview.title: Platform Overview
landing.overview.desc: We created this project to address the challenge of chaotic self-education. By utilizing AI-generated roadmaps, we help learners master complex technical disciplines with ease while avoiding "tutorial hell".
landing.features.graph.title: Interactive Knowledge Graph
landing.features.graph.desc: Visualize your learning journey. Our dynamic graph displays dependencies and connections between courses for a perfect structural understanding.
landing.features.lessons.title: AI Lessons (Gemini)
landing.features.lessons.desc: The platform generates detailed, up-to-date, and interactive lessons on the fly using high-performance AI models.
landing.features.lang.title: Multilingual Support
landing.features.lang.desc: Our interface and educational materials are fully adapted and available in two languages: English and Russian, ensuring a comfortable immersion into the learning process.
landing.features.game.title: Gamification & Progress
landing.features.game.desc: Track your daily streaks, unlock achievements, and compete in leagues to keep your learning motivation high.
landing.team.title: Project Team
landing.team.di.task1: Designed the platform's architecture and overall product concept.
landing.team.di.task2: Integrated high-speed AI inference (Gemini API) for course generation.
landing.team.di.task3: Developed the UI/UX design, glassmorphic interfaces, and animations (Framer Motion).
landing.team.ad.task1: Scaled the infrastructure and integrated Firebase services (Auth, Firestore).
landing.team.ad.task2: Engineered the interactive knowledge graph leveraging Vis-Network.
landing.team.ad.task3: Configured routing, internationalization (i18n), and client-side application logic.
